# Original TC4 item and block names in Thaumcraft 4 Reload

<!-- Generated by scripts/porting/extract_legacy_ids.py from common/src/main/resources/data/thaumcraft/tc4/legacy_ids.json. Do not edit by hand; run the script and `--check` fails while this file is stale. -->

Thaumcraft 4.2.3.5 (Minecraft 1.7.10) named its content by a field of `thaumcraft.common.config.ConfigItems` / `ConfigBlocks` plus a metadata value. Minecraft 1.21.1 has no metadata: every variant is a separate item or block, a block state, or a data component. This table maps every original field and every metadata value the original used to the native id.

It covers 156 fields (111 items, 45 blocks) and 472 field/metadata pairs: 463 map to a native id, 9 have no 1.21.1 counterpart (the note says why). Each field also has a wildcard row (`32767`).

## Use from an add-on

```java
ItemStack ingot = ItemApi.getItem("itemResource", 2);          // thaumcraft:thaumium_ingot
ItemStack slab  = ItemApi.getBlock("blockSlabWood", 0);        // thaumcraft:greatwood_slab
ResourceLocation id = ItemApi.legacyItemId("itemShard", 6);     // thaumcraft:balance_shard
BlockState state = ItemApi.legacyBlockState("blockCosmeticSolid", 1); // cosmetic_solid_tough[variant=1]
List<ResourceLocation> any = ItemApi.legacyItemIds("itemShard", 32767); // all seven shards
Item thaumometer = ItemsTC.get("itemThaumometer");             // an original field name, metadata 0
Block jar = BlocksTC.get("blockJar");                          // thaumcraft:jar
```

* A native id (`thaumium_ingot`, `thaumcraft:thaumium_ingot`) keeps resolving as before.
* An unknown name logs the original warning and returns `null`; an original field name never throws.
* `getItem`/`getBlock` return `null` for a row whose id (or, for a block, item) is `null`, and for a wildcard of a field with several native ids; `legacyItemIds` lists those ids.
* `getBlock` gives a block row whose state is not the default state and whose item is the block's own item the `minecraft:block_state` component, so placing the stack gives the original state (a top slab, a cosmetic variant). Other components are only described here: an add-on sets them itself (for example the aspect of a filled phial).
* The `name` column is the original English name from the 1.7.10 language file.

Evidence: `Class.method:lines` / `Class:line` are source lines of the original class files (LineNumberTable), `en_US.lang` names the original language key, `(world)` marks a world placement.
